title: A limit above $0 sent for a COD customer is refused by the server
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Send a save for a COD customer with a credit limit of 500 by a means other than the window (the window locks the limit at $0.00).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The save is refused with "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." and the form stays open.

A manual tester cannot reach this (S5-03 and S5-04 check the lock). It is for an automated check.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Story 5, Error Handling: “If a limit above $0 is sent for a COD or Credit Hold customer, Save is refused with "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." The form stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Limit above $0 sent for COD or Credit Hold (server) | "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." | Standard error alert, form stays open”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "5 New Customer", "6 Customer on a deactivated term" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the window locks Credit Limit at $0.00 for COD and Credit Hold, so only a save sent outside the window can reach this refusal
